verdicts.reason: HOL4 introduces `instance` via `new_specification`, which saves only `instance_def` (guarded by `FLOOKUP tmsig name = SOME ty0`) and discards the Hilbert-choice witness. At `FEMPTY` the guard fails, so HOL4 leaves `instance FEMPTY i name ty τ = (@f. P f) FEMPTY i name ty τ` open even with choice fixed. Lean defines `instance' := select P` transparently, proving that equation by `rfl`.

Lean defines `termsem0` with catch-all `| _, Abs _ _ => ARB`, proving `termsem0 mem tmsig i v (Abs (Const name ty) b) = ARB` (and similarly for `Comb`/`Abs` binders) by `rfl`. HOL4's `Definition termsem_def` goes through TFL with nested pattern `Abs (Var x ty) b`; it saves equations only for given patterns and `DefnBase.delete_support` deletes the auxiliary tupled constant and its underlying definition, leaving non-`Var` `Abs` binders open.
